content.title: How to stream every March Madness game on TNT this weekend for free
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation. By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.com Bring on the madness. The 2026 NCAA Tournament officially starts today with the round of 64. Fans looking to catch games on TNT can score free trials and deals with these options: March Madness TNT Streaming Options Streaming Options DirecTV Stream Sling HBO Max Price/Month $94.99 $49.99 $18.49 Free Trial Yes N/A N/A Deal $35 off the first month N/A N/A Start Free Trial Try Sling Try HBO Max DirecTV Stream: TNT, TruTV, TBS and CBS are all available through DirecTV Stream’s Choice plan, which is $94.99 per month. New customers can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off the first month of their subscription. Sling Monthly Plans: TNT is available with Sling’s Orange plan as well as its Orange and Blue plan. The Orange plan comes with 34 channels for $45.99 per month and the Orange and Blue plan has 55 channels for $64.99 per month. New subscribers can take half off the first month of their Orange and Blue subscription . Sling Day Pass: Customers can also utilize the Sling TV day pass with the Entertainment Extra plan to score TBS, TNT and TruTV for $5.99 per day. HBO Max: In addition to hit TV shows and movies, HBO Max’s plans offer live sports, starting at $18.49 per month with the Standard plan. Michigan State vs. North Dakota State on TNT The No. 3 Michigan State Spartans will open their March Madness journey tonight against the No. 14 North Dakota State Bison. Tipoff is scheduled for 4:05 p.m. ET on TNT. Which other first-round games are on TNT?
